defects.claim: Description: 'Kneel upright and draw both shoulder blades together, opening the chest wide with arms relaxed at the sides. Lift through the sternum for a confident, grounded posture.' Requires UPRIGHT torso with chest OPEN (slight back extension). Under CORRECTED convention 'spine + = forward lean, - = backward arch', spine should be 0 (upright) or slightly NEGATIVE (slight back arch for 'chest open' + 'lift through sternum'). Current spine=+32 (STRONG FORWARD FOLD) — OPPOSITE of description. Head pitch +33° (chin down, looking down) — opposite of 'lift through sternum'. Pose NAME 'Kneeling Bow' suggests forward bow, but description says upright + chest open — NAME-DESCRIPTION MISMATCH. Per protocol §4, description is source of truth.
defects.evidence: geometry.json: torso_flexion_deg=+32 (strong forward fold), head_pitch=+33° (chin down), spine z=+0.138 (forward of hips).

failing_tests.assertion: spine <= 0 (upright or slight back arch for 'chest open' + 'lift through sternum')

regression_risk: low — single-field spine sign flip + magnitude reduction. No arm/leg changes. Verified head lift + chest opening via geometry.
rationale: CRITICAL fix: spine 32→-8 (FLIP from strong forward fold to slight back arch). Arms at sides (low abduction) UNCHANGED — 'arms relaxed at the sides' ✓.
